newsitem.title: FINLAND: Four arrested after summit protests.
newsitem.headline: Four arrested after summit protests.

text.p: Four human rights protesters were arrested early on Thursday near the Helsinki summit hotel of U.S. President Bill Clinton, police said.

A group of 16 demonstrators protesting against alleged human rights breaches in Russia and the United States held a noisy protest outside Clinton's central Helsinki hotel at around 1.20 a.m. (2320 GMT), banging kitchen pot lids and blowing whistles.

The group was dispersed by police after a few minutes but four of them reappeared later in the night at around 3 a.m. (0100 GMT) in a street near Clinton's hotel. The four refused to disperse and were arrested, police said.

Later on Friday, a group of about 50 Iraqi Kurds also staged a demonstration against Iraqi President Saddam Hussein, near the site of the summit meeting between Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin, Finnish radio reported.
